definitions.VALID_RUN: missing trials <= max_missing_trials_per_run_frac AND trigger desync <= tolerance AND high-motion frame fraction <= max_high_motion_fraction AND max abs displacement <= limit AND all mandatory events present
definitions.VALID_SESSION: >= min_valid runs of its type with contiguous acquisition and usable fieldmap/anat
definitions.INVALID_SESSION: fewer than min valid runs or missing anat/fieldmap
definitions.TECHNICALLY_INCOMPLETE_PARTICIPANT: valid imagery/perception units below minima OR withdrew/failed before minimum acquisition -> replaced per participant_plan; enters denominator as technically incomplete, NEVER re-classified by neural reliability

replacement_behavior: a TECHNICALLY_INCOMPLETE_PARTICIPANT is replaced up to the recruitment ceiling; a technically-complete participant is NEVER replaced regardless of R_I/R_P/Delta/PASS
